en: Sepia-toned photograph of an inner cloister or courtyard with arcaded walkways. The image shows a series of stone columns supporting rounded arches, with potted plants lined along the balustrade in the foreground. Across the courtyard, another arcade with smaller arches and a decorative balustrade is visible, along with weathered plaster walls, arched windows, and traces of frescoes. The architectural style is reminiscent of a Renaissance or late-medieval cloister in Southern Europe.
